name: MaskPaintCanvas
purpose: Paint/erase a natural-pixel mask over a contain-fitted source image with adaptive ResizeObserver fit, official zoom + pan, and optional checkerboard.
scenarios: Watermark / inpaint mask editing with whole-image contain fit.
Transparent PNG editing with checkerboard backdrop.
Export mask blob at natural resolution matching on-screen strokes.

fit.description: Default contain: whole image visible and centered in the stage.

mode.description: Paint white mask strokes or erase them.

brushSize.description: Brush diameter in CSS pixels (screen space).

checkerboard.description: Show token-toned checkerboard for transparent media.

checkerboardContrast.description: Checker A/B contrast when checkerboard is on. Defaults to strong for mask editing.

zoom.description: User zoom relative to contain-fit; 1 = fitted. Controlled when set (pair with zoomChange / onZoomChange). Handle: zoomIn/zoomOut/resetZoom/setZoom/getZoom.

wheelZoom.description: Wheel to zoom inside the stage (preventDefault; no page-scroll conflict). Pan when zoomed: middle-drag or Space+drag.

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the stage.

antiPatterns: Sizing the stage with consumer 62vh / content-height hacks instead of a definite host or fill-parent.
Using Canvas / CanvasToolbar pan-zoom for mask paint export.
Faking zoom with consumer CSS transform scale() on the stage — it breaks pointer → natural-pixel mapping; use the built-in zoom API.
Nesting WorkspaceSplit inside detail for canvas|tools.

a11y.focus: Pointer painting is the primary input; pair with labeled mode controls outside.
a11y.labeling: Provide nearby labels for mode / brush / clear.

responsive.strategy: Fill parent; ResizeObserver re-runs object-fit:contain math on stage resize.

breakpoints.compact: Same contain fit; host should still give a definite block size (e.g. WorkspaceSplit pane).
breakpoints.large: Same; prefer tools in WorkspaceSplit #tools so detail height stays definite.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS; pointer math uses getBoundingClientRect.
